## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest reusable change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran the relevant build/tests locally or explained why I could not.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I checked keyboard and accessibility behavior for UI changes.
- [ ] I reused existing shared components/patterns before adding new primitives.
- [ ] This change does not include credentials, tokens, private keys, production configuration, customer data, or other secrets.
- [ ] This change does not add third-party code/assets without compatible rights and attribution.

## Notes

Call out API compatibility, migration requirements, visual changes, or follow-up work here.
